page_title: WHU 3-1 CHE | West Ham v Chelsea 20/08/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, John Brooks has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+5' 3 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) low into the right of the net, giving goalkeeper Robert Sanchez no chance!
90+5' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is going to take the penalty!
90+4' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee John Brooks saw the whole situation. PENALTY! Wonderful opportunity to score for West Ham.
90+3' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
90+3' Chelsea get a corner.

90+2' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) had a good chance to change the score. He ran towards the goal and unleashed a shot from just outside the penalty area which went towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper was ready and made an amazing save.

90+1' Pablo Fornals (West Ham) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Robert Sanchez makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.

90' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves John Brooks with no other option than to blow for a foul.
89' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
83' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to substitute Malo Gusto and he is replaced by Mason Burstow (Chelsea).
83' Chelsea have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
82' The referee points to the corner flag and Chelsea will take a corner.
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and James Ward-Prowse trots off the pitch and is replaced by Edson Alvarez (West Ham).
81' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Levi Colwill (Chelsea) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post.
80' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) aims a low effort to the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
79' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
78' John Brooks blows his whistle after Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
76' A substitution has been made. Michail Antonio is replaced by Pablo Fornals (West Ham).
75' Mauricio Pochettino has decided to make a change. Noni Madueke (Chelsea) replaces Conor Gallagher.
75' Axel Disasi (Chelsea) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
72' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) is booked for saying more than John Brooks was willing to tolerate.
69' It is time for a substitution. Angelo Ogbonna (West Ham) is on for Mohamed Said Benrahma.
69' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
67' Nayef Aguerd (West Ham) sees a yellow card in the hand of John Brooks. And as it's a second one this game, a red follows and Nayef Aguerd (West Ham) is sent from the pitch.
66' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the left post.
65' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
65' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee blows his whistle, West Ham are awarded a corner kick.
63' A rebound bounces out to Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.

62' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) attempted to send a defence-splitting pass into space where Raheem Sterling was lurking. It could have put him one-on-one with the goalkeeper, but one of the defending players somehow manages to avert the threat.
61' We are about to witness a substitution. Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is replacing Ben Chilwell.
60' A cross, provided by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea), caused no threat to the opposition's defence as the ball was cleared out of danger.

60' It looks like Emerson (West Ham) saw red with that tackle. John Brooks won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Chelsea.
56' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Alphonse Areola comes off his line to intercept.
53' 2 - 1 Goal! Michail Antonio (West Ham) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner.
51' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
50' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
50' Golden chance! Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) meets a cross in the box and finds some space for a shot. He produces an inaccurate effort that goes wide of the right post.
50' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
49' Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) is penalised after knocking an opponent down.
49' A spell of possession for Chelsea in an attempt to control the game.
47' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee John Brooks signals.
46' Substitution. Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) on for Carney Chukwuemeka.
46' The second half has just started.
45+10' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+9' Flag up against Jarrod Bowen (West Ham). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
45+6' Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
45+4' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
45+4' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Alphonse Areola has no trouble gathering it.
45+3' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) finds some space inside the box and gets in a strike, but the shot is brilliantly blocked by one of the defending players sliding in.
45' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Emerson (West Ham) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
43' Penalty saved! Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sends the penalty towards the left hand side of the goal, but Alphonse Areola pulls off a wonderful save to deny him.
43' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
43' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Chelsea!
43' Referee John Brooks makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Chelsea. Let’s see what happens!
42' Tomas Soucek (West Ham) jumps into a tackle and John Brooks signals a foul. The referee points to the penalty spot. Chelsea are awarded a penalty kick!
40' Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but John Brooks ignores the protests.
40' The Chelsea players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
37' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is angry with himself. The ball breaks to him but he hits the right post!
36' A yellow card for a tackle by Axel Disasi (Chelsea). John Brooks doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
35' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) was probably a bit loose with his words to John Brooks, who decides to show him a yellow.
35' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Chelsea comes to nothing.
35' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
35' Vladimir Coufal (West Ham) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
33' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) is flagged for offside.
33' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

32' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball is out of play and Chelsea manage to earn a corner.
28' 1 - 1 Goal! Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea) fires the rebound inside the right post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.
25' Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) connects with a cross from the side, but produces a header which goes miles wide of the left post.
24' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
22' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the roof of the net, but Alphonse Areola is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
22' A lofted cross from Raheem Sterling (Chelsea) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
20' The resulting corner from Ben Chilwell (Chelsea) is cleared by the defence.
20' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Raheem Sterling (Chelsea). It will be a corner kick for Chelsea.
19' Chelsea seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
17' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
17' Mohamed Said Benrahma (West Ham) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
14' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) misses a good chance to score. A perfect cross into the box finds Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) who rises for a header, but he sends the ball well over the bar.
13' Today's referee John Brooks rightly decides to book Nayef Aguerd (West Ham) for his harsh tackle.
13' Michail Antonio (West Ham) evades several challenges inside the box and fires a shot in on goal, but that's a great block by the defender to stop an almost certain goal.
10' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Chelsea players are visibly unhappy with the call.
10' There's a break in play and referee John Brooks must have got a signal in his ear as he indicates he will check that earlier penalty claim by Chelsea using VAR. This could be interesting!
9' Flag goes up against Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
9' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.

7' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Nayef Aguerd (West Ham) gets on the scoresheet after converting a chance from the resulting corner kick. He finds himself some space inside the box and plants a perfect header down inside the left post. 1:0.
7' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
5' Kurt Zouma (West Ham) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
5' James Ward-Prowse (West Ham) will take a corner kick.
5' Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
3' Looks like Lucas Paqueta (West Ham) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
2' Great teamplay by Chelsea as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
1' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea).
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Chelsea will have the kick-off.
John Brooks will referee today's match.
Show lineups Before the start of the game, you can see the starting lineups for today's clash.
